editorial:
Imagine a world where high school drama meets alien technology and total chaos. You get to follow three girls who couldn't be more different: A-ko, who loves food and hitting things; B-ko, the smart and competitive rival; and C-ko, who is just happy to be there. The vibe is totally wild and over-the-top, starting with a giant spaceship that has been turned into a fancy shopping mall and resort. It feels like a giant cartoon party where the rules of physics don't exist, and the goal is basically just to see how much destruction A-ko can cause while trying to have a normal summer break.

The animation is super smooth and the action scenes are some of the best from the 80s. You will love how fast the plot moves, though it can get a bit confusing since it jumps around so much. The best part is the funny rivalry between the lead girls. If you enjoy loud, colorful stories with giant robots and space battles, you need to see this.
endingExplained: Everything comes to a head when the Daitokuji group tries to use the ship for their own power. After a massive battle involving giant robots and huge explosions, A-ko uses her insane strength to save the day. The aliens finally get the help they need to fix their ship and head back to space. The movie ends with the girls returning to their usual chaotic lives, proving that no matter how big the alien threat is, A-ko is still the strongest.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves 80s anime and wild action comedy.
